items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping, which suits the low moisture reading.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream supports a comfortable, well-moisturized look for dry-feeling skin.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides helps protect the look of uneven tone from sun and visible light, and it suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Please ask your doctor or a dermatologist whether your hydroquinone cream is right to continue during pregnancy, as we are not adding any more brightening products. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF every morning as the last step.
